prompt: Create a high-end studio product render of a single crocodile-shaped gummy candy on a pure black background. The candy is a translucent emerald-green gelatin crocodile facing right, with a glossy wet surface, rounded molded body, raised bumpy scales across the back and sides, four short squat legs, a long curved tail arcing upward over the body, and an open snout with small rounded teeth. The inside of the mouth and lower jaw glow in translucent red-orange gummy, creating a candy-like edible branding effect. Use macro product photography lighting with strong white specular highlights, visible tiny air bubbles suspended inside the gelatin, realistic refraction and subsurface scattering, a faint green glow along the base, and a subtle dark reflection underneath. Center the crocodile horizontally, show it in side profile at a slightly low angle, keep the composition minimal and premium, ultra-realistic 3D render, sharp focus, no text, no packaging, no extra objects.

promptZh: 创作一张高端摄影棚风格的产品渲染图，展示纯黑色背景下的一颗鳄鱼形状软糖。这颗软糖呈半透明的祖母绿色，鳄鱼造型面向右侧，表面湿润且具有光泽，身体圆润，背部和侧面有凸起的鳞片，四肢短粗，长尾巴向上弯曲，张开的嘴里露出圆润的小牙齿。口腔内部和下颚呈现出半透明的红橙色，营造出一种类似糖果的可食用品牌视觉效果。采用微距产品摄影布光，带有强烈的白色高光，软糖内部可见细小的气泡，呈现逼真的折射和次表面散射效果，底部带有淡淡的绿色光晕，下方有细腻的暗色倒影。将鳄鱼水平居中，以略微低角度的侧面轮廓展示，构图保持极简且高级，超写实 3D 渲染，焦点清晰，无文字，无包装，无额外物体。
